guarantees.claim: digest_size is assigned the value of digest_size_supplied when it matches SHA2_256, SHA2_384, or SHA2_512; otherwise digest_size is assigned SHA2_None.

assumptions.claim: Downstream logic must treat digest_size = SHA2_None as an illegal configuration, preventing HMAC/SHA-2 operation and signaling an error to software.
assumptions.cond: when digest_size is used to start HMAC/SHA-2 computation
assumptions.risk: If the downstream logic does not block, an unsupported digest size could lead to undefined or weaker cryptographic operation, compromising integrity.

uncertain_points.claim: It needs to be verified that the top-level control logic blocks HMAC/SHA-2 start whenever digest_size equals SHA2_None, and that the error signal is asserted before any computation begins.
uncertain_points.cond: When hardware receives a start trigger with an unsupported digest size
uncertain_points.risk: A race condition could allow a computation to start with an invalid digest size before the error stops it, leading to a security bypass.
